description: This file defines a base activity class for Android applications, providing common setup for logging and lifecycle management.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class extending FragmentActivity to handle common initialization, especially logging setup.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the onCreate method to perform initial setup, currently just calls superclass implementation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Overrides the onStart method to initialize logging when the activity becomes visible.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging by creating a LogWrapper and associating it with the Log class, then outputs a 'Ready' info log.
